The *Sīlasampanna Sutta* ("Accomplished in Ethics", Iti 104) belongs to the *Catukkanipāta* (Chapter of the Fours) of the *Itivuttaka*, located at page 106 in the Pali Text Society edition. The discourse addresses the spiritual benefits and rewards that arise from associating with those who genuinely qualify as admirable friends (*kalyāṇamitta*).

 However, automated text-reuse analysis in DharmaNexus identifies substantial phraseological overlap with other Pali canonical corpora [DharmaNexus].
